signal: Consensys launched the MetaMask Agent Wallet in June 2026, letting AI agents trade across DeFi, while preparing a potential 2026 IPO with JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs.

email.body1:
Ray, saw Consensys just launched the MetaMask Agent Wallet and is lining up a potential 2026 IPO.

Momentum like that usually means more partner and enterprise accounts in play than business development can cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Consensys off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ray, quick follow-up for Consensys.

A launch and an IPO runway usually expand the accounts worth chasing faster than headcount can ramp, so partner pipeline goes untouched and the quarter quietly leaks. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to cover it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings business development needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ray, last bit of proof for Consensys.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Consensys reply rate likely compares to other blockchain-infrastructure companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ray, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling business development coverage without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and an IPO runway is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your BD motion? I will tailor it to Consensys either way.
